derivation.bands_from: the pipeline's per class defaults in tools/pbr_bake.py, not measurement of the art
derivation.caveat: No record here is a per texture judgement. A record with a material states which node and which field named it; a record without one sets no bands. Both carry review_required.
derivation.material_from: the class tools/pbr_bake.py's classify_node reads out of the node's own footstep sound, drawtype or material group
notes: The footstep sound carries most of this file and it is a sound, not a material. Mineclonia gives cake and beds mcl_sounds_cloth, melon default_wood_footstep and every grass topped block default_grass_footstep, so cake_top and cake_inner are recorded as cloth, farming_melon_top as wood and mcl_core_grass_block_top as leaves. Those are the game's sounds faithfully read, not judgements about the art.

76 node textures carry no material evidence at all and are recorded without one. 48 of them are the mcl_villages crop and decoration set (bush_N, flower_N, gourd_N, grain_N, root_N, tree_N), the rest are mcl_levelgen's jigsaw and structure block faces, the slime and honey blocks, redstone dust, the player skin sheets and the two flame animations. Of those, the mcl_villages set is plant art and a reviewer would almost certainly call it foliage; the file does not, because the registration does not.

Mineclonia's own digging groups were checked as a second source and are not used: pickaxey, axey, shovely and shearsy name a class for only 4 of those 76 textures (mcl_amethyst_amethyst_block, mcl_amethyst_budding_amethyst, mcl_conduit_conduit_node and mcl_pale_oak_chiseled_resin_bricks), because the rest are dug by hand and carry handy or dig_immediate, which say nothing about material.

leaves is the pipeline's only cut-out vegetation class, so crystal and fungus sprites drawn with drawtype plantlike (mcl_amethyst_amethyst_bud_small, farming_crimson_fungus, farming_warped_fungus) land there too. Read it as cut-out organic, not as foliage.

Entity skins are not in this file. pbr_packs/manifests/mineclonia-entities-intake.json holds the 130 entity dump, but an entity definition carries no footstep sound, group or drawtype, so there is nothing to derive a class from.

The 17 ore textures under mcl_core, mcl_deepslate and mcl_nether were corrected by hand from stone to mixed with partial metalness. Their footstep sound is the surrounding stone's and says nothing about the ore in them.
